para.en: ❶ Several artificial intelligence (AI) technologies described in films are now a reality. ❷ One of them is self-driving cars. ❸ In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system. ❹ The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention. ❺ Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars. ❻ Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road. ❼ Additionally, many other AI technologies from movies are either in use or under development.

❶ This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet. ❷ However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing. ❸ This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality. ❹ In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000.” ❺ It provided the audience with the chance to understand AI. ❻ It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data. ❼ In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft. ❽ Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step. ❾ The system could even draw logical conclusions and evaluate its decisions. ❿ The AI helper for a spaceship, which was only seen in the film at the time, has become a reality. ⓫ In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON. ⓬ It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft. ⓭ CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts. ⓮ The robot assists astronauts in more effectively accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work. ⓯ It is also able to record and film the astronauts’ activities when asked.

❶ Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002. ❷ It features AI-based advertisements that can identify individuals from a remote distance by scanning people’s eyes. ❸ There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall. ❹ After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be appealing to him. ❺ Nowadays, we frequently encounter personalized advertisements provided by AI. ❻ For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI. ❼ Their AI systems provide us with advertisements based on our previous searches or other online behavior. ❽ Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed. ❾ However, those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation. ❿ They can identify a person only if he or she is standing still. ⓫ On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation. ⓬ They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking. ⓭ There has been continuous development of this technology up until now.

❶ This is a science fiction animation that was released in 2014. ❷ There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot. ❸ The robot scans the boy’s body to detect potential health problems using its sensors and cameras. ❹ What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm. ❺ It administers medicine on the wound. ❻ In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax checks his hormone levels to determine the cause of his mood swing. ❼ These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry. ❽ Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer. ❾ AI robots are also used in operating rooms. ❿ Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more. ⓫ Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery. ⓬ Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse. ⓭ It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit. ⓮ The medical team intervenes when a patient’s scores reach a certain level.

❶ AI has been progressing rapidly over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized. ❷ It is certain that AI will continue to play a significant role in more and more aspects of our lives. ❸ Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI. ❹ Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do. ❺ Furthermore, some AI characters are physically indistinguishable from humans. ❻ These movies are not only fun to watch, but also inspiring. ❼ They show us what AI might be like in the future and how it could affect us. ❽ What AI technology from a movie do you think will be used in our lives in the future?

howto.cloze: 빈칸을 하나씩 보여 줘요. 우리말 뜻·유의어·첫 글자 힌트를 보고 원문 표현 그대로 쓰고 Enter(또는 다음 빈칸)를 누르세요. 빈칸을 모두 채워야 다음 지문으로 넘어가요.
howto.tf: 글과 일치하면 T, 아니면 F를 누르세요. 문장을 하나씩 보여 주고, 누르면 다음 문장으로 넘어가요. 지문은 아래 상자 안에서 스크롤하며 읽어요. 결과 화면에서 F 문장의 고칠 부분과 근거를 확인하세요.
